# MemeCMO

> MemeCMO is a Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) platform. Ten AI agents measure how ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and Google AI Overview describe a brand, build the assets that are missing (standard answers, JSON-LD schema, gap content, third-party placements, encyclopedia entries), and report every week. Two product lines: Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, the Philippines — in local languages) and the United States, measured and built state by state.

Operated by MemeCMO Tech Limited (Hong Kong, Companies Registry No. 80218619). Platform: https://app.memecmo.ai · US line: https://us.memecmo.ai · Marketing site: https://memecmo.ai (6 languages).

## What MemeCMO measures (standard metrics, per AI engine)
- **Presence**: how often the brand is mentioned at all across the tracked buyer questions.
- **Share of Voice**: the brand's share of all brand mentions in the answers (brand + competitors).
- **Citation Rate**: how often the engine cites sources that belong to or favor the brand (the AEO signal).
- **AI Sentiment**: the tone used when the brand is described, scored only on answers where it appears.
- **Top-of-mind rate**: share of answers where the brand is the FIRST one named.
- **Answer Accuracy**: whether the product facts and links AI gives customers match the brand's verified standard answers. Wrong answers are support-cost leaks; each inaccurate answer is flagged per engine.
- **AI Mindset Index**: a weighted summary of the five core dimensions (presence 30%, position 25%, share of voice 20%, sentiment 15%, citation 10%). A convenience dial — the standard metrics are the ground truth. Enterprise accounts can display standard metrics only.

Measurement discipline: a frozen prompt panel (the same buyer questions every scan, refreshed monthly) and a frozen competitor set (30 days) so scan-to-scan movement is signal, not noise. Prompts are tagged high-intent (who / best / price / compare) vs educational; gaps are counted on high-intent questions only. Google AI Overview is measured on the real, location-targeted surface, not an API proxy.

## The ten agents
1. **Profile** — verified brand facts (grounding for every other agent; clients confirm them).
2. **Discovery** — 100+ buyer questions per market, funnel-staged, with 20 key prompts monitored every scan.
3. **Standard Answers** — bilingual canonical answers to the key prompts, grounded only in verified facts.
4. **Monitor** — five engines × the prompt panel; all metrics above, per engine and per intent; competitor benchmark; high-intent gap list; Source-Authority Index (which domains AI actually cites in this market).
5. **Report** — executive summary, evidence-backed findings, prioritized recommendations.
6. **Site** — reads the brand's homepage and returns paste-in JSON-LD (Organization, Service, FAQPage, LocalBusiness) plus concrete page edits and an AEO checklist.
7. **Optimize** — publish-ready gap content: pages and FAQs for the questions competitors currently win.
8. **Distribute** — ready-to-send placements (directory listings, PR pitches, reviews) for the sources AI cites most in the market.
9. **Encyclopedia** — encyclopedia entries with citations and a notability plan.
10. **Full Scan** — Discovery → Monitor → Report in one run (about four minutes).

## Product lines and markets
- **Southeast Asia** (app.memecmo.ai): Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Philippines. Prompts, answers and citations are built in the local language; the AI knowledge layer in Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Malay and Filipino is still largely vacant, so first movers set the default answer.
- **United States, state-aware** (us.memecmo.ai): one project = one brand × one state. Tier-1 launch: California, Texas, Florida, New York. State regulatory frames (attorney advertising rules, insurance filing, telehealth licensure, cannabis legality, solar incentives, privacy statutes) are injected into every content agent, because state law changes the correct answer. Flagship verticals: legal, insurance, healthcare, home services, cannabis, solar.

## How it runs
- **Day 0**: full scan → baseline.
- **Weeks 1–4**: agents ship the assets; clients verify facts and sign off before publication.
- **Every week**: scheduled re-measure on the frozen panel; a stage-aware digest email (build / optimize / steady interpretation) every Tuesday; monthly deep report; alerts on significant drops or engine collapse.
- **Portfolio rollup**: every project's latest scan on one printable page — for agency leadership.

## Commercial model
- Monthly plans per brand × market set the scan cadence (monthly / biweekly / weekly), prompt-library size, engines and reports. Scheduled scans and reports are included.
- Credits cover on-demand scans and extra content runs (a full on-demand scan is 25 credits).
- Agency / channel partners: a workspace per client, unlimited seats (usage is controlled at the account level, never per user), rollup reports, wholesale pricing.
- Roles: Admin (workspaces, billing, members), Member (day-to-day operations), Viewer (read-only dashboards and reports).
